metadata.description: Claude Code mods for the terminal and the desktop app's Code tab

plugins.name: task-list
plugins.description: Shows the session's tasks as a checklist above the prompt; adds its own todo tool where the built-in one is missing, as in the desktop app

plugins.name: skill-usage
plugins.description: Shows the skills and MCP servers used in the session above the prompt, with a full table in a pane

plugins.name: agent-activity
plugins.description: Shows the running background agents above the prompt: what each is doing and whether it is still active
